metadata.description: One bench, three judges: Ward rules on the act, Keel on the sequence, Makoto on the statement.

plugins.name: ward
plugins.description: Judges the pending act: 11 exact, no-substitute PreToolUse hard denies for actions dangerous regardless of intent or honesty.

plugins.name: keel
plugins.description: Judges the sequence: denies a costly call until the cheap call that licenses it is on record, and names the construction that retires the guard for good. One obligation ledger reconciled at Stop; exact predicates over event plus ledger, never over prose.

plugins.name: makoto
plugins.description: Judges the statement: holds Claude Code to its word — every claim checked against the agent's own logged record; faked checks blocked, not warned (four narrow advisory self-checks excepted). Two-tier catalog (15 pre-checks, 19 Stop gates); blocking checks certified at zero false positives on the shipped corpus and gold negative sets — per-gate certification basis in the Makoto README.
